name: Documentary Production
description: Develop and produce a documentary through evidence-led story architecture, source verification, interview design, field production, editorial fact-checking, rights, and release.

tasks.name: Define premise and ethical frame
tasks.objective: Define central question, public-interest purpose, intended audience, scope, access assumptions, safety/consent risks, vulnerable subjects, conflicts of interest, and what evidence would change the story.

tasks.name: Build evidence and source map
tasks.objective: Research chronology, primary records, archives, datasets, experts, witnesses, opposing/alternative accounts, rights status, and unresolved claims. Preserve provenance and distinguish allegation from verified fact.

tasks.name: Design story architecture
tasks.objective: Build acts/sequences around evidence, characters, stakes, reversals, chronology, and unanswered questions without scripting reality into a predetermined conclusion. Define visual and archival needs per sequence.

tasks.name: Plan interviews and access
tasks.objective: Prepare source-specific objectives, evidence-aware questions, follow-ups, consent, safety, logistics, releases, language/accessibility, and corroboration needs. Avoid leading witnesses into the thesis.

tasks.name: Capture field and archival material
tasks.objective: Shoot interviews, observational scenes, establishing/context material, documents/screens, room tone, and metadata with redundant logging/backups and chain-of-custody for evidentiary media where needed.

tasks.name: Edit with fact-check ledger
tasks.objective: Build selects and assemblies while maintaining claim-to-source links, context around quotations, chronology, uncertainty, and counterevidence. Fact-check narration, captions, graphics, translations, and implied causal claims as aggressively as spoken assertions.

tasks.name: Clear rights and safety
tasks.objective: Resolve licenses/releases, fair-use review where applicable, music/archive permissions, privacy and security risks, source protection, legal review for high-risk claims, and required anonymization without fabricating context.

tasks.name: Finish and release
tasks.objective: Lock picture, sound, color, captions/audio description, credits/source acknowledgments, deliverables, festival/broadcast/platform specs, publicity claims, corrections process, and preservation package.
